name: cep
description: Unified engineering plugin: scope, plan, build, check, ship, and learn. Forked from Compound Engineering, sharpened with pstack's execution discipline and gstack's outer-loop review, sign-off, and shipping practices.

interface.shortDescription: Scope, plan, build, check, ship, and learn — one command surface across three engineering disciplines.
interface.longDescription: cep unifies six phases of engineering work behind six commands: Scope (product framing and specialist sign-off), Plan (implementation planning with type-first discipline), Build (execution with reproduce-first and prove-it-works gates), Check (debugging and tiered code review), Ship (QA through production deploy, gated behind safety hooks), and Learn (knowledge compounding). Tool names resolve per host via references/codex-tools.md.
defaultPrompt: Scope this feature before we plan it.
